title: May Explain Path Inventory
methodology: Direct source-code inspection of may-core.js, test_may_stagec.js, test_tutoring_safety.js

explainPaths.name: _explainAnswer
explainPaths.description: Primary explain answer method. Called from handleAction('explain') and freeform chat routing.
currentBehavior: Displays correct answer letter and choice text
If ExplanationCorrect > 30 chars: includes it verbatim as the full explanation
If ExplanationCorrect is thin/empty: states topic + section context only
Adds topic progress note if learner has >=2 attempts on the topic
Adds case-specific coaching notes (whatMattered, approachNote) for case items
Routes through _guardedSpeak in pilot mode, _speak in non-pilot

gating.activeUnanswered: No gating — caller is responsible. _explainAnswer does not check if learner attempted answer

tests.currentAssertion: Verifies ExplanationCorrect substring appears verbatim in output
tests.updateTo: Includes bank ExplanationCorrect AND adds tutor-layer insight

tests.test: _explainAnswer does not fabricate when explanation is thin
tests.currentAssertion: No ASC/FASB fabrication on thin explanations
Guarded speak path exists for explain

explainPaths.name: miniExplain
explainPaths.description: Mini-panel explain. Called from mini-panel button (exam view).
currentBehavior: Gates: requires learner to have attempted answer (state.session.answers[qid] exists) OR session completed (review mode)
If not attempted and not review: shows 'Try answering first ...' message
If attempted or review: reveals correct choice, answer text, and ExplanationCorrect snippet (250-char truncated)

gating.examMode: Not explicitly blocked — but mini panel hidden during full exam

tests.test: C-08: miniExplain blocks answer when no attempt recorded
C-08b: miniExplain blocks answer when session is null
C-09: miniExplain reveals answer in review mode

guardedSpeakIntegration.usage: Called from _explainAnswer, _explainWrongChoices, _provideHint, _simplifyExplanation, and insight methods when pilot mode is active

summary.guardedSpeakIntegration: Preserved — tutor-layer output must route through _guardedSpeak in pilot mode
summary.note: miniExplain is intentionally simpler (in-exam view). Primary tutoring enhancement should focus on _explainAnswer for full May tab review mode. miniExplain can receive a light touch — truncated tutor output.
